content: COSI state.CoreState: Get, List, Create, Update, Destroy, Watch, WatchKind, WatchKindAggregated. Event{Resource, Old, Error, Bookmark, Type}; EventType in {Created, Updated, Destroyed, Bootstrapped, Errored, Noop}. WithBootstrapContents(true) makes WatchKind emit the current set as Created events then a Bootstrapped marker - i.e. list+watch in one call. Talos exposes this via client.COSI. Server side: cosi-project/runtime/pkg/state/protobuf/server.NewState(coreState) wraps any CoreState into the gRPC State service, enabling an in-process fake Talos resource API.
